evidence_sources.description: Global and machine-level confusion matrix, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and threshold calibration metrics on frozen test partition.
Sequence-level reconstruction error threshold, confusion matrix, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and per-machine breakdown on 580 test sequence windows.
Common granularity comparative benchmark aggregating Isolation Forest point scores across 30-step windows vs LSTM Autoencoder.
Attribution mode match rates, contribution percentages, and signed standardized residuals across faulted machines M102, M104, M107, M109.
Formal technical audit establishing NO-GO decision for tree-based supervised failure-risk forecasting under existing chronological split.
Additive efficiency metrics, background sample distribution, archetype waterfall values, and local latency benchmarks on 70-sample cohort.
Multi-class confusion matrix, per-class precision/recall/F1/ROC-AUC, and CPU latency benchmarks on 92 frozen test images.
Parameter counts (2,804,708 total), layer configurations, training history (35 epochs), and cryptographic checksum.
Numerical parity across direct model vs unified service, latency percentiles, and concurrency lock verification.
118-test regression inventory, multimodal pairwise routing, fuzzing results, tracemalloc telemetry, and frozen partition quarantine.
Forensic audit resolving historical Step 7 report clerical hash error and confirming true immutable disk digest.

isolation_forest.evaluation_unit: Point-level tabular reading (5 continuous sensor channels)
isolation_forest.dataset_scope: Frozen test partition (sensor_test.csv), 6,000 readings across 10 machines (600 readings/machine)
scientific_limitations: Evaluated strictly on synthetic data where fault amplitudes exceed 15 to 39 standard deviations.
Point-level evaluation suffers from 6.69% false alarm rate on nominal baseline readings due to transient Gaussian tail excursions.
Zero-shot evaluation on completely unseen machine assets drops recall to 48.86%–76.14% without asset-specific threshold calibration.

lstm_autoencoder.evaluation_unit: Sequence window (30 timesteps = 150 minutes, stride 10 = 50 minutes, 5 channels)
lstm_autoencoder.dataset_scope: Frozen test partition (sequences_test.npz), 580 sequence windows across 10 machines (58 windows/machine)

healthy_machines_m101_m103_m105_m106_m10.mean_reconstruction_error: 0.685 to 0.710 across healthy fleet (well below 0.9015 threshold)

scientific_limitations: Sequence windows overlap by 20 timesteps (stride 10, window 30), violating statistical sample independence across consecutive evaluation items.
Sequence-level metrics cannot be directly compared to point-level Isolation Forest metrics without temporal aggregation.
Model learns temporal autocorrelation patterns of synthetic Gaussian noise and step transitions rather than complex physical machine dynamics.

granularity_harmonization.finding: Aggregating Isolation Forest point predictions over 30-timestep windows completely eliminates or drastically suppresses transient point-level false alarms (dropping FP from 241 down to 0 for mean score, or 9 for max score), demonstrating that apparent accuracy differences between IF (0.9598) and LSTM (0.9931) were primarily artifacts of evaluation granularity rather than fundamentally superior anomaly separation.

sensor_level_attribution.evaluation_unit: Per-feature attribution percentage and signed standardized residual (z-score space)
sensor_level_attribution.dataset_scope: 58 anomalous sequence windows per faulted machine (N=232 anomalous windows total)
scientific_limitations: Attribution results demonstrate mathematical alignment with the programmed synthetic equations in generate_sensor_data.py; they do NOT demonstrate real-world physical root-cause diagnostic capability.
LSTM Autoencoder squared reconstruction errors reflect model reconstruction failure rather than direct physical energy dissipation.
Isolation Forest ablation delta measures tree score sensitivity under feature replacement, not additive Shapley value attribution.

failure_risk_feasibility.verdict: NO-GO — Supervised tree-based regression training not justified under chronological dataset design
failure_risk_feasibility.models_trained: NONE (Random Forest and XGBoost training formally rejected)

technical_reasons.training_input_truncation: Under purged chronological split (train: steps 0 to 2799, horizon H=288 steps), training inputs span steps 0 to 2511, terminating 89 steps prior to synthetic fault activation at step 2600. Consequently, the training input partition contains exactly 0.0% progressive degradation data.
technical_reasons.target_range_discrepancy: Maximum training target risk is 0.2090, whereas maximum test target risk is 0.9000 (test-to-train ratio of 4.31x). Random Forest is mathematically bounded by the convex hull of training targets [0.0, 0.2090] and cannot predict test targets in (0.2090, 0.9000]. XGBoost can extrapolate outside training targets, but axis-aligned splits route extreme degradation inputs to boundary leaves without learning physical slopes.
technical_reasons.sensor_pre_onset_noise: Baseline sensor telemetry prior to step 2600 consists of stationary i.i.d. Gaussian noise with zero progressive trend (|r| < 0.06 against future risk targets).
technical_reasons.pseudoreplication: 25,120 training input observations originate from only 10 physical machines (4 faulted, 6 healthy). In experimental design, repeated longitudinal measurements across 10 units constitute pseudoreplication with 1-to-1 machine-to-fault confounding.

failure_risk_feasibility.alternative_architecture: Preserve Isolation Forest and LSTM Autoencoder anomaly detection as the telemetry foundation for Phase 3 Multi-Agent LangGraph supervisory health tracking.

kernel_shap_explainability.evaluation_unit: Local Shapley value attributions per feature for Isolation Forest negative decision function
kernel_shap_explainability.background_provenance: Validation set normal readings (val_features.npy), 5 observations per machine across 10 machines, base seed 42
kernel_shap_explainability.evaluation_cohort: 70 selected observations from test partition (7 observations per machine)
scientific_limitations: The evaluated test cohort contains 70 curated observations, NOT the full 6,000-point test partition.
Kernel SHAP explains the mathematical behavior of the Isolation Forest decision function; it does NOT provide physical root-cause explanations.
Feature perturbations are sampled marginally (p(x_S) * p(x_C)), which can evaluate off-manifold synthetic feature combinations when physical correlations exist.
Trained and evaluated exclusively on synthetic procedural images generated with high-contrast geometric defect overlays and clean synthetic textures.

Images were randomly partitioned across splits rather than held out by machine or manufacturing batch; does NOT evaluate generalization to unseen machines, lighting variations, optical distortions, or factory environments.
Local single-worker CPU forward pass latency (156.57 ms) is an isolated computational benchmark, NOT an end-to-end production serving SLA.

unified_inference_service.evaluation_unit: Multimodal API inference request (tabular reading, sequence window, defect image)

sequence_anomaly_lstm.note: Mean inflated by a single 72.56-second OS background garbage collection/paging pause outlier during 1 of 100 iterations; median (108.61 ms) reflects true representative execution.

architectural_limitations: Concurrency relies on in-process serialization locks (_tf_lock for Keras/TensorFlow and _shap_lock for Kernel SHAP) to prevent C-extension race conditions, serializing concurrent multi-threaded requests in a single worker.
Configured timeouts are passive evaluation deadlines rather than preemptive C-extension thread cancellation mechanisms.
Model registry is a process-local singleton; multi-process deployment (e.g. Uvicorn/Gunicorn) requires independent model instances per worker process.
Initial composite invocation exhibits empirical cold-start latency of approximately 6.04 seconds on the local host.

regression_validation.evaluation_unit: Pytest automated test items across complete backend codebase

frozen_partition_quarantine.synthetic_fixtures: test_lstm_autoencoder.py (580x30x5 normal, seed 42) and test_sensor_attribution.py (50x30x5 normal + injected anomalies, seed 42)

regression_validation.distinction: 100% test pass rate validates software interface contracts, error boundaries, concurrency lock integrity, and regression resistance; it does NOT establish statistical generalization or real-world predictive validity.

scientific_integrity_disclosures.D01_synthetic_sensor_dataset: The sensor dataset is purely synthetic, generated via scripted mathematical formulas and random distributions in ml/data_generator/generate_sensor_data.py.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D02_ten_machines_fleet: Only 10 machine assets are represented (M101 through M110). Repeated longitudinal observations across 10 machines constitute pseudoreplication.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D03_machine_fault_confounding: Four fault types are strictly coupled 1-to-1 with four specific machine IDs (M102=overheating, M104=bearing wear, M107=pressure drop, M109=lubrication failure). Machine identity and fault type are completely confounded.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D04_deterministic_fault_patterns: Fault progressions are programmed linear and polynomial trends injected on top of stationary Gaussian noise.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D05_fixed_onset_step_2600: Fault dynamics activate at the exact fixed timestep 2600 (65% of the 4,000-step timeline) for all faulted machines.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D06_overlapping_sequence_windows: Sequence evaluation uses 30-step windows with stride 10, meaning consecutive windows share 20 timesteps (66.7% overlap) and violate sample independence.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D07_random_image_split_limitations: The 600 synthetic images were split randomly (70/15/15) across train/val/test rather than by machine or generation batch, precluding claims of generalization to unseen machines or real factories.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D08_failure_risk_no_go: Failure-risk prediction was formally closed as a NO-GO feasibility assessment; zero Random Forest or XGBoost models were trained or deployed.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D09_attribution_is_not_causal: Sensor attribution and Kernel SHAP measure model mathematical decision boundaries and residual reconstruction errors, not real-world physical causal mechanisms.
scientific_integrity_disclosures.D10_defect_01_schema_bypass: DEFECT-01 remains open in backend/app/ml/inference/schemas.py:86-94, where partial timestamp arrays bypass chronological monotonicity validation.

unresolved_technical_issues.description: Chronological monotonicity is only checked when len(timestamps) == len(self.readings). If a sequence has 29 valid timestamps and 1 None, len(timestamps) == 29 != 30, skipping monotonicity verification without raising an error.
unresolved_technical_issues.remediation: Hardening scheduled for Phase 3 schema milestone to require all-or-nothing timestamp arrays.

unresolved_technical_issues.description: Process-level threading locks serialize concurrent inference for Keras and Kernel SHAP within a single worker process.
unresolved_technical_issues.remediation: Deploy multi-process worker pool (e.g. Uvicorn/Gunicorn workers) for horizontal concurrency.

unresolved_technical_issues.description: Initial composite inference invocation exhibits empirical cold-start latency of approximately 6.04 seconds.
unresolved_technical_issues.remediation: Implement container pre-warming or pre-warmed worker initialization in production deployment.

unresolved_technical_issues.description: LSTM Autoencoder latency benchmark exhibited a 72.56-second single-sample pause outlier due to background OS garbage collection/paging during iteration 68.
unresolved_technical_issues.remediation: Tune memory management and GC thresholds in production serving container.

unresolved_technical_issues.component: Isolation Forest and LSTM Autoencoder Zero-Shot Generalization
unresolved_technical_issues.description: Zero-shot evaluation on completely unseen machine assets yields recall drop to 48.86%–76.14% due to machine-specific baseline operating parameter variations.
unresolved_technical_issues.remediation: Require machine-specific baseline calibration window before activating anomaly monitoring on new assets.
